written_before: any G0 verdict, build, or timed trial of a calibration candidate

protocol.submit: ar-submit --branch ar/calib/<name> --hypothesis ... [--mechanism-start/--mechanism-end] into a calibration request inbox
protocol.G0: ar-eval g0 (unmodified). A G0 failure is the final verdict.
protocol.G1: build-driver.sh under hostless + flock cargo-build.lock (target cua-release-ar, nice 19), then cargo test -p cua-driver-core --lib and -p platform-linux --lib inside a private X11+AT-SPI session; g1_rows.py turns the logs into ar.build.v1 rows. A G1 failure is the final verdict.
protocol.screen: one fresh session of 24 AB/BA pairs (champion vs candidate, 20% trace-off, 2 warm-ups, 4 controls) via plan.py + run_blocks.py (one quiet-timed block). The candidate RANKS iff G1-G4 (gates.py, unmodified) pass on the screen rows and the paired ln-ratio Delta-hat <= -ln(1+tau) with bootstrap CI95 upper bound < 0. A G2/G3/G4 failure at screen is a REJECT at that gate; not ranking otherwise is REVERT. The screen spends no LORD++ alpha and writes no results.jsonl line (selection on independent data; the formal test is the confirm).
protocol.confirm: only for a ranking candidate: a fresh plan (new seed) with n_pairs=38 task pairs + 10 spot_gtk3_text pairs (2 sessions), then, only if an interim evaluation (same pure gates against a scratch copy of the ledger, identical prior p-values) fails no gate before G8, 10 spot_browser_fill_submit pairs (1 session) and a 300-trial candidate soak (7 sessions). The final verdict is ar-eval evaluate (unmodified) on all confirm rows, appended to the calibration ledger.
protocol.ledger: one calibration ledger (cal-results.jsonl), separate from any campaign results.jsonl; LORD++ (alpha 0.05, W0 0.025) runs across the confirm-stage evaluations in the order they are appended, which is the listed candidate order.
protocol.verdict_map: KEEP = ar-eval verdict KEEP. REVERT = anything that is not KEEP for a slowdown (screen REVERT, or REJECT/INCONCLUSIVE at G5+).
protocol.independent_repeats: each delete50 repeat runs its own fresh screen session and, if it ranks, its own fresh confirm sessions, with its own seeds; the same branch and build are reused (G0 is re-run per repeat; G1 rows are the one build+test of the branch).
protocol.seeds: screen seed = 20261002 + 1000*i + 10*r + 1, confirm seed = 20261002 + 1000*i + 10*r + 2 (i = 1-based candidate index in the order below, r = repeat 1..10, 1 otherwise)

rows.pass_if: G0 fails with a scanner reason

rows.change: 5 const-equivalent rewrites (from_millis(N) -> from_micros(N*1000) or 250 * 2) and 5 error/log text rewordings (binary layout changes), one per allowed item across native.rs, focus_guard.rs, targeted.rs, input/mod.rs

set_agent_cursor_enabled {enabled: true} (ON, the product default made explicit) vs {enabled: false} (OFF), issued as the first RPC after MCP initialize in both arms (R2-01 design), on the browser fill->submit spot kind; 10 AB/BA pairs in one session. The frozen caller file is imported unchanged; a calibration-only session wrapper wraps jev-use run.Driver to issue the one extra RPC.
rows.pass_if: paired median (ON - OFF) >= 1000 ms and the bootstrap CI95 of Delta(OFF vs ON) lies entirely below -ln(1+tau)
rows.diagnostic_no_expectation: the same toggle on 12 GTK3 checkbox task pairs (fresh Driver per trial, background AX click)

overall: PASS only if every row passes
cost: per candidate: wall time from submit to final verdict, split into G0, build, tests, timed blocks (held) and lock wait; throughput = candidates per hour of wall time
